TournamentHelp.scheduleThree: The form prevents creation when the knockout rounds would run past gameweek 38.
TournamentHelp.createOne: The tournament name is checked before submission.
TournamentHelp.createTwo: After creation, the page reports whether setup is ready, processing, or needs attention.
TournamentHelp.createThree: You can view the tournament when creation succeeds.
TournamentHelp.editQuestion: Can I edit a tournament after creating it?
TournamentHelp.editAnswer: Tournament owners can update the name or delete the tournament from its management page.
TournamentHelp.fetchQuestion: Why must I fetch a league first?
TournamentHelp.fetchAnswer: The fetched league supplies the real FPL entry IDs used by the tournament. Custom selection changes which fetched entries are included.
TournamentHelp.scheduleQuestion: How is the knockout schedule calculated?
TournamentHelp.scheduleAnswer: The form calculates the required rounds from the qualifying entries and elimination format, then places them after the group stage.
TournamentHelp.processingQuestion: What if setup is still processing?
TournamentHelp.processingAnswer: The tournament has been accepted, but its backend setup is not ready yet. Keep the status and check again later.
